 ORDER

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 211/2023 dated 24.6.2023 registered at Police Station Bilkhiriya, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366-A,
376(2)(N) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: 2. The counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

It is contended that at the time of incident the age of the prosecutrix was Abhishek Jatav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67691926/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. has clearly stated that she on her own volition went out with the applicant and later on she was recovered.
The prosecutrix in her supplementary statement also has stated that she on her own volition established physical relations with the applicant.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in custody since 22.10.2023 and trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be released on bail.

3. The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that there are direct allegations against the applicant and at the time of incident the prosecutrix was minor, therefore,
the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

4. Heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

On perusal of case diary, it reflects that the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. as well as in her supplementary statement has stated that she on her own volition went with the applicant and had established physical relations with him.
The age of the prosecutrix was about 17 years at the time of incident and the applicant was also aged about 20 years.

Therefore,
looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation against the applicant, age of the prosecutrix as well as the applicant, the period of custody of the applicant and also that trial would take considerable time to conclude, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant Abhishek Jatav shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.

7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
